name: VS-Code
description: The full Visual Studio Code desktop app, streamed straight to your browser.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Your VS Code home folder, with your login session, editor settings, extensions and project files.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: HTTPS web interface with a self-signed certificate. Open this one in your browser. Published on host as 6119.

ports.name: Port 3000
ports.description: Plain HTTP web interface, meant to sit behind a reverse proxy. Published on host as 6120.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: CUSTOM_USER
variables.description: The username for the VS Code login screen. admin is fine, or pick your own.

variables.name: PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the VS Code login screen. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start. Find it in /mnt/cache/appdata/vscode/password.txt (open it with the Files app) or in the app log. Or type your own here.
